strings.zh: 武藏『小鬼头,坂木老大已经{NEWLINE}消灭了精灵联盟,{CLEAR}联盟冠军这种头衔自然就不存在了。{CLEAR}识相的话就赶紧投降,{CLEAR}我们还能收你做个跟班。
strings.en: Jessie: Listen, brat. Boss Giovanni has{NEWLINE}already wiped out the Pokémon League.{SCROLL}So naturally there’s no such thing as a{NEWLINE}League Champion anymore.{SCROLL}If you know what’s good for you,{NEWLINE}surrender now, and we might take you on{CLEAR}as our lackey.

strings.zh: 小三郎『做跟班？说什么傻话啊,{NEWLINE}把他做成人棍还差不多。
strings.en: Butch: A lackey? What kind of dumb talk{NEWLINE}is that?{SCROLL}Chop off his arms and legs and make a{NEWLINE}human stump out of him, more like.
strings.notes: #167 male player (him) / #168 female player (her). 人棍 (limbless ‘human stump’) kept at full strength per D-0627.

strings.zh: 小三郎『做跟班？说什么傻话啊,{NEWLINE}把她做成人棍还差不多。
strings.en: Butch: A lackey? What kind of dumb talk{NEWLINE}is that?{SCROLL}Chop off her arms and legs and make a{NEWLINE}human stump out of her, more like.

strings.zh: 小次郎『人棍什么的太过分了吧？{NEWLINE}还是收一个小弟{CLEAR}每天给自己端茶倒水比较好吧？
strings.en: James: A human stump is going way too{NEWLINE}far, isn’t it?{SCROLL}Wouldn’t it be better to take on an{NEWLINE}underling who serves us tea every day?

strings.zh: 喵喵『我要小鬼头{NEWLINE}每天给我挠痒痒啊喵。
strings.en: Meowth: I want the brat to scratch my{NEWLINE}back every day, meow.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『看来你们不打算让开,{NEWLINE}那我也不跟你们废话了。{CLEAR}做好被揍的准备吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Looks like you’re not going to{NEWLINE}move. Then I’m done talking.{SCROLL}Get ready for a beating!

strings.zh: 亚玛多『有了传说中精灵加持的我们,{NEWLINE}跟以前可是大不一样了。
strings.en: Cassidy: With legendary Pokémon backing{NEWLINE}us up, we’re nothing like we used to be.

strings.zh: 小三郎『看我们联手干掉你,{NEWLINE}拿下火箭队的头功！
strings.en: Butch: Watch us team up and take you{NEWLINE}out, and win top honors in Team Rocket!

strings.zh: 亚玛多『啊！怎么还是跟原来一样……
strings.en: Cassidy: Ah! Why is it the same as{NEWLINE}always...

strings.zh: 小三郎『这下不妙了……
strings.en: Butch: This is bad...

strings.zh: 武藏『笨蛋亚玛多,{NEWLINE}多谢你替我们消耗小鬼头啊。
strings.en: Jessie: Thanks for wearing down the{NEWLINE}brat for us, you idiot Cassidy.

strings.zh: 小次郎『打倒小鬼头的功劳归我们了。
strings.en: James: The credit for beating the brat{NEWLINE}goes to us.

strings.zh: 喵喵『小鬼头留下来给我挠痒痒吧喵！
strings.en: Meowth: Brat, stay here and scratch my{NEWLINE}back, meow!

strings.zh: 武藏『好讨厌的感觉。
strings.en: Jessie: Looks like Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}blasting off again...

strings.zh: 小次郎『我们这是输第几次了？
strings.en: James: How many times have we lost now?

strings.zh: 喵喵『猫的跟班没有了喵。
strings.en: Meowth: There goes this cat’s lackey,{NEWLINE}meow.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我赶着去石英高原,把路让开！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m in a hurry to get to the{NEWLINE}Indigo Plateau. Out of my way!

strings.zh: 亚玛多『我让精灵吃了这么多苦,{NEWLINE}怎么还是跟原来一样无法打败你啊……
strings.en: Cassidy: I put my Pokémon through so{NEWLINE}much...{SCROLL}So why can I still never beat you, same{NEWLINE}as always...

strings.zh: 武藏『明明被打败了很讨厌,{NEWLINE}但怎么反而有点安心呢？
strings.en: Jessie: Losing should feel awful... So{NEWLINE}why do I feel kind of relieved instead?

strings.zh: 小次郎『按理说我们跟着火箭队{NEWLINE}干出这么大名堂来应该很高兴。{CLEAR}但当真的要接替精灵联盟时,{CLEAR}我竟然开始发抖了。{CLEAR}哎,这是怎么回事啊。
strings.en: James: By rights, we should be thrilled{NEWLINE}to pull off something this big with{CLEAR}Team Rocket.{SCROLL}But now that we’re really about to take{NEWLINE}over from the Pokémon League, I’ve{CLEAR}started shaking.{SCROLL}Ugh... What’s wrong with me?

strings.zh: 喵喵『我们的故事就到此为止了吗喵？
strings.en: Meowth: Is this where our story ends,{NEWLINE}meow?
